name: Missing Wait Until Condition
hint: The finder detects a wait-until block with no Boolean condition. The block cannot know when to continue, so it waits indefinitely and prevents the following code from running.
instruction: Add a condition that can eventually become true and reflects the event the script must wait for; use a timed wait instead when no condition is required.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
wait until <>
say [done]

examples.label: Possible solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
wait until <key \[space v\] pressed?>
say [done]
